events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: John Cleese is 87! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, he's given us some of the most iconic comedy moments. Which is your favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. What's your go-to track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991, leaving behind an indelible mark on music.

angles.name: Forever A Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost Freddie Mercury, but his voice and stage presence remain unmatched. A true icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul', featuring classics like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A Timeless Classic
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh today as it did back then.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this day, we remember music icon John Lennon, who was tragically killed in 1980, but whose message of peace and love continues to resonate.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Forty-six years since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message are as powerful as ever.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today, a true innovator and chameleon of rock.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: David Bowie would have been 80 today. An artist who constantly reinvented himself and inspired generations. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Celebrating the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have marked his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His influence on music is simply unmatched.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitar legend and influential producer Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the maestro, Jimmy Page! The riffs he gave us are legendary. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice and decades of hits, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Timeless Tunes
angles.copy: Sir Rod Stewart is 82 today! What's the Rod classic that always gets you singing along?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of British ska legends Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 66th to Suggs! Our House, Baggy Trousers... so many unforgettable Madness tunes.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, famed for his soulful voice and 80s hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st to Paul Young! Still got that incredible voice. Which of his hits is your favourite?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Dolly Parton would have been 81 today. Her incredible songwriting and spirit continue to inspire across the globe.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and producer Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th to Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend, what's your favourite Gary moment?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British soul and R&B singer Billy Ocean, known for global hits like 'Caribbean Queen', celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Smooth Soul
angles.copy: Happy 77th to the one and only Billy Ocean! His smooth vocals are truly timeless.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The very first induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held on this day in 1989, honouring pioneering artists who shaped rock music.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years since the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who do you think should be in there now?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member and solo artist Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th to Mark Owen! Always a key part of the Take That magic.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles took to the rooftop for that iconic concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis drummer and hugely successful solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his solo hits, what's your favourite Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar, actor, and former *NSYNC member Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Justin Timberlake is 46 today! From *NSYNC to solo chart-topper, he's done it all. What's your favourite JT song?

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, known for iconic roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Inspector Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly!
angles.copy: Happy 87th to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! Which of his legendary characters always makes you smile?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, rock and roll pioneers Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event famously known as 'The Day The Music Died'.

angles.name: A Tragic Day
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. A sombre day in music history.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famed for his 80s smash hit 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Him Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st to Rick Astley! Still got the moves and that voice. What's your favourite Rick Astley track?

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have marked his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His music and message of peace continue to unite the world.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary American singer-songwriter Carole King, known for her seminal album 'Tapestry' and countless hits, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits
angles.copy: Happy 85th to the incredible Carole King! A true songwriting genius. What's your favourite song penned by her?

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the unparalleled talent and voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away in 2012.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost Whitney Houston, but 'The Voice' lives on. Her songs still give us goosebumps.
